memoryfight-warm.title: Memory Library — the fight (warm cut)

scenes.content: A couple mid-argument across their kitchen counter in warm evening light, both gesturing at once over unwashed mugs, exasperated but domestic, a tabby cat watching from the counter end.
scenes.motion: both talk over each other with rising hand gestures; the cat's tail flicks; neither backs down

scenes.content: In the living room she makes exaggerated air quotes while he throws both hands up toward the ceiling, mid-eye-roll, a couch and warm lamps behind them.
scenes.motion: her air quotes punch the air; his hands fly up; he turns half away in disbelief

scenes.content: The two of them suddenly quiet, leaning shoulder to shoulder over one phone held between them on the couch, both squinting at the screen skeptically.
scenes.motion: they lean in together; the phone light catches their faces; eyebrows rise in unison

cards.caption: The day we got the cat — two Novembers ago

scenes.content: The couple on the couch gone soft, her head tipping toward his shoulder, both half-smiling at the phone while the tabby cat climbs deliberately into both their laps at once.
scenes.motion: her head tips to his shoulder; he huffs a laugh; the cat settles across both laps

segments.text: Every couple has this fight. The one about how the thing actually went.
